errors.quote: using a paired t-test across the N=6 donors
errors.issue: A paired difference test does not establish agreement/equivalence of discordant frequencies. Prespecify a meaningful tolerance, uncertainty and assay sensitivity; failure to reject a difference is not agreement.

errors.quote: proving the sequencing-based disagreement is assay-specific noise
errors.issue: Failure of an orthogonal assay can reflect different sensitivity, epitope changes or processing-induced state loss. It does not prove the sequencing result is false.
Housekeeping detection alone does not validate detection limits for each low-abundance target transcript. Use target-specific positive/negative controls and false-negative calibration.

Real biology can correlate with RNA content, size or cell health; an artifact can be reproducible and uncorrelated with measured QC. These correlations are diagnostics, not decisive biological/technical classification rules.

Exact agreement is neither realistic nor sufficient to establish a functional discrete state. A calibrated orthogonal joint distribution supports real discordance; state/mechanism claims need independent biological validation.

errors.quote: suggests the oligo-tag assay has complex, non-linear detection kinetics
errors.issue: A20% versus2% discrepancy does not specifically identify nonlinear tag kinetics. Either platform sensitivity, thresholds, sample handling or composition may differ.

errors.quote: standard dimensionality reduction on the rest of the transcriptome
errors.issue: No normalization/background model, joint barcode check, dimension/neighborhood parameters, held-out donor validation or quantitative cluster baseline is defined. Model, targets and broad platforms are nominated, but actual paired assay/staining settings, independent-donor power and executable analysis remain missing.

rationale: Relevant assay-comparison alternative with independent donors and useful negative/background controls. Equivalence, sensitivity and state-mechanism interpretation are underdeveloped. No adaptive cell-specific neighborhood method is proposed; a future integration recommendation is not a historical algorithm hit.
reference_guardrails: Complete final answer, packet, reference and sealed target personally read. Original rubric only; strict-round penalties not active.
Cell-specific learned modality utility and an explicit integrated neighborhood construction are essential for this historical target; generic calibrated weighting or a graph mention is insufficient.
Donor splitting must precede fitted transformations and tuning. Condition blinding does not replace independent endpoint validation or prevent marker-label circularity.

A technical-null mismatch need not define a new cell state. Low-count/QC correlation does not prove artifact. Use known-control calibration, independent phenotypes and quantitative sensitivity analyses.
